presentation.row_diagrams: Eight real SRAG teaching records, selected by the first adult records per observed outcome; each new feature starts from original inputs. Recorded row-level predictions are replayed, not calculated by XGBoost in the browser.
presentation.results: The mechanism compares Brier on the displayed teaching subset. A separately labelled full-test reading, ranking and repeat trace use the complete temporal evaluation.
presentation.source_figures: modules/00-dataset/notebooks/srag_pfi_ranking.ipynb sections 9, 11 and 14; exported SVG copies unchanged.
presentation.teaching_source: modules/00-dataset/gold/pfi_slide_explainer.json preview; explicitly projected into data/pfi-teaching-records.json by project_teaching_records and checked by validate_teaching_records in tools/srag_72_pfi_presentation.py.

included_data: Separate aggregate and teaching-record files. Aggregates include errors, ranking summaries, dataset-level repeat traces, study counts and fixed-model protocol. Teaching records include age, low-oxygen category, observed outcome and recorded original/permuted probabilities, classes and squared errors. No source identifiers, dates, location fields, contingency tables, subgroup tables or snapshots; identifier omission is not a claim of anonymization.
